paper_title: Paper Copilot A Self-Evolving and Efficient LLM System for Personalized   Academic Assistance
caption: Efficient deployment methods dramatically reduce the time cost. The average total time cost before efficient deployment is 87.1s (26.2s + 60.9s), which is reduced by 69.92% after efficient deployment.

The smaller slice is colored blue, corresponds to the "Efficient deployment" category, and features internal text showing an absolute value of "26.2s" alongside a percentage of "(30.08%)." Visual emphasis is applied to the blue "Efficient deployment" slice, which is exploded, or slightly offset, from the other segment. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the category names are positioned directly outside their respective slices, while the precise values and percentage labels are nested inside the slices. As a visual observation, the larger orange slice comprises the vast majority of the circular area, with the significantly smaller offset blue slice situated in the upper right.
